answer: A sybil farm buys accounts by the thousand; SIM tenure attestation makes each purchase a bad deal: a SIM held for years on the same number, confirmed by the carrier. The canyon of the defence is the sunk cost - the credential is earned slowly, in person, over years, and cannot be transferred or faked in bulk. A farm needs a hundred of them, and the knoll in each is a separate real-world trail with its own witnesses. The tundra that closes it is the audit, which checks the trail in seconds and never haggles.
